statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient has transient neurological symptoms, including brief visual disturbances and mild aphasia
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation contributing to transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.0, and Z86.73
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service was denied because it is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
